verdict.rationale: RevenueCat offers scheduled data exports (recurring delivery of app data to cloud storage or email on a schedule), which is a form of recurring job scheduling, but there is no evidence of general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduling for AI-native automation beyond this single reporting feature. missing for 10: evidence of configurable recurring workflows/triggers beyond data exports, AI-agent-driven scheduling via MCP/AI toolkit, and any API/dashboard support for creating custom scheduled jobs.
